vagas.descricao_completa:
NOSSO NEGÓCIO
Aqui na Programmers, aceleramos grandes ideias com inovação e tecnologia. Com uma trajetória de mais de 30 anos, o que nos move são os desafios em construir ideias em soluções reais, para que nossos clientes sejam referências no segmento que atuam.
Especialistas em desenvolvimento de software e inteligência de dados, temos uma relação de transparência, confiança, credibilidade e reconhecimento neste mercado.
Nosso maior sonho? Impactar empresas e pessoas.
O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ?
Buscamos um profissional com 
forte background em desenvolvimento de software e arquitetura de sistemas
, que tenha experiência prática na construção e operação de soluções baseadas em 
IA Generativa e arquiteturas multiagentes
.
Essa pessoa será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e evoluir arquiteturas de agentes, garantindo 
orquestração eficiente, integração entre agentes e sistemas, escalabilidade, observabilidade, segurança e qualidade das soluções
.
Esperamos alguém com perfil hands-on, capaz de atuar tanto nas decisões de arquitetura quanto na implementação do 
backend e dos componentes que sustentam os agentes de IA
.
PARA ESSA OPORTUNIDADE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:
Experiência prática na construção e implementação de agentes de IA e sistemas multiagentes, indo além do consumo de APIs de LLMs;
Vivência com frameworks de agentes e orquestração, como LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen ou similares;
Experiência na orquestração de múltiplos agentes, definindo responsabilidades, fluxo de execução, comunicação, memória, ferramentas e mecanismos de decisão entre os agentes;
Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software, especialmente em backend, APIs, microsserviços e integrações, utilizando linguagens como Python, Java, C# ou similares;
Conhecimento de arquitetura e backend para aplicações baseadas em agentes, incluindo APIs, gerenciamento de estado, filas, bancos de dados, integrações com serviços externos e mecanismos de persistência;
Experiência com LLMs, RAG, tool calling/function calling, embeddings, vector databases e gestão de contexto;
Conhecimento de observabilidade e monitoramento de aplicações de IA, considerando performance, latência, consumo de tokens, custos, erros e qualidade das respostas;
Vivência com avaliação (evaluation) de agentes e aplicações de IA, utilizando métricas e estratégias para avaliar qualidade, confiabilidade, precisão e comportamento dos agentes;
Conhecimento de engenharia de prompts e técnicas de otimização de contexto, visando melhorar a performance e a confiabilidade dos agentes;
Capacidade de atuar na definição de arquitetura, avaliando trade-offs técnicos e escolhendo as melhores estratégias para escalabilidade, segurança, custo e manutenção.
SERIAM PONTOS DE DESTAQUE SE VOCÊ TIVER:
Experiência em colocar arquiteturas multiagentes em produção;
Experiência com MCP (Model Context Protocol) e integração de agentes com ferramentas e sistemas externos;
Vivência com arquiteturas envolvendo human-in-the-loop;
PARA UMA VIDA MAIS SAUDÁVEL, TE PROPORCIONAMOS:
Política de Home Office
Plano de saúde, com cobertura nacional
Plano odontológico
Convênio com Sesc
Wellhub
TE APOIAMOS COM:
Vale refeição ou alimentação
Auxílio creche
Participação nos resultados
Licença parental estendida
Nossas vagas são para todos!
Valorizamos a diversidade, pois ela impulsiona a inovação, fortalece nossas soluções e torna nosso ambiente mais inclusivo. Cada diferença é uma oportunidade de aprendizado, tornando nosso dia a dia mais inspirador e nossas entregas ainda melhores.

About CloudWalk:
We are not just another fintech unicorn. We are a pack of dreamers, makers, and tech enthusiasts building the future of payments. With millions of customers and a hunger for innovation, we're now expanding our neural network - literally and metaphorically.
Ready to see the direct impact of your code on business results and customer lives?
Join our Collection team as a Software Engineer and help shape the future of debt recovery at CloudWalk!
You'll be building end-to-end collection journeys that maximize debt recovery while maintaining an exceptional customer experience.
This role combines technical excellence with AI-powered solutions to accelerate delivery and drive measurable impact.
What You'll Do
Build & Scale: Develop intelligent, scalable solutions for collection journeys that handle high-volume debt recovery operations.
Design Customer-Centric Experiences: Create comprehensive renegotiation and installment strategies that balance recovery goals with customer satisfaction.
Leverage AI for Impact: Use artificial intelligence to prioritize tasks, automate workflows, and accelerate feature delivery.
Collaborate & Iterate: Work cross-functionally with Product, Data, and Customer Success teams to test and implement recovery strategies.
Measure & Optimize: Analyze customer behavior data to measure impact and continuously iterate on collection approaches.
What You Need to Succeed
Love Building Backend Solutions: Have solid software development experience with backend technologies, preferably Python (though we're open to other backend languages too).
Embrace AI & Automation: Are familiar with generative AI tools and models, ready to integrate them into real-world applications.
Are Genuinely Curious: Have authentic interest in credit, collections, and debt recovery domains—you want to understand the business impact.
Drive Results: Are impact-oriented with a focus on solving real problems and delivering measurable outcomes.
Thrive in Fast-Paced Environments: Can balance technical excellence with urgency and customer-first thinking.
Advanced/fluent English for communication
Nice to Have
Fintech Experience: Previous work in credit, collections, or financial services.
Analytics Skills: Comfort with data analysis tools and the ability to derive insights from customer behavior patterns.
AI/ML Background: Experience building or deploying machine learning models in production environments.
The Future We See:
At CloudWalk, we envision a future where AI empowers every field to reach new heights:
 People teams leveraging AI to transform talent acquisition and employee development.
 Marketing professionals creating data-driven, AI-powered campaign strategies.
 Customer Success teams enhancing client experiences with intelligent solutions.
 Risk analysts combining human expertise with AI to navigate complexities.
 Designers collaborating with AI to push creative boundaries.
Join us at CloudWalk, where we're not just engineering solutions; we're building a smarter, AI-driven future for payments—together.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

About us
 
About DataSquads UG
DataSquads UG is a remote-first software development and consulting company with teams in Germany and Brazil. We specialize in building Proof of Concepts (POCs) and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) for startups, helping them turn bold ideas into scalable products. Our hands-on approach combines agile project and product management with deep technical expertise across UX/UI, frontend and backend development, and DevOps.
Whether you're validating a new idea or scaling your early-stage product, we act as an extension of your team to deliver fast, reliable results that move your business forward.
Typesense & Python Developer (m/f/x)
 
Join an international team that drives innovation from Germany to Brazil and turns digital visions into reality. At DataSquads, you'll work remote at the forefront of startup development.
Our Mission:
 We empower startups through world-class MVPs and agile processes to bring their ideas to market quickly and scalably.
Your Responsibilities
 
You develop high-performance search solutions with Typesense for our international customer projects.
You design and implement scalable backend systems based on Python.
You work closely with our teams in Germany and Brazil in a remote-first environment.
You support DevOps processes to ensure smooth application deployment.
You optimize existing database queries and ensure excellent data quality.
You accompany the entire software lifecycle from the initial idea to the finished MVP.
You actively contribute your expertise to the technical consulting of our startup partners.
Your Profile
 
You have at least five to seven years of solid professional experience in software development.
You possess expert knowledge in Python and have successfully implemented complex projects.
You are a pro in handling Typesense and optimizing search algorithms.
You have very good knowledge in backend development and fundamental knowledge in DevOps.
Your Portuguese skills are at C2 level and you communicate confidently in English (C1).
You work independently, in a structured manner, and value the dynamics of agile startup environments.
Apply Now
 
We look forward to your quick online application for a start on July 2nd, 2026. Become part of our squad!
